contractRulesVerified.rtpContractText: RTP includes base-game RTP and jackpot contribution; exact numeric RTP is placeholder in PDF, therefore operator page 94.74% remains the current JOKERBET-bound published figure.

independentProviderEvidence.redTigerJackpotArchitecture: Official Red Tiger factsheets for jackpot-capable titles state that with-jackpot base RTP is paired with a jackpot contribution and that the jackpot contribution itself has 100% RTP. This architecture is supporting evidence only; do not transfer another title's exact base RTP to this JOKERBET configuration.

facts: Red Tiger timed tiers can use a visible countdown.
Daily tier becomes hot during a bounded pre-deadline window in that operator configuration.
10 Minute Drop is guaranteed every 10 minutes.
Contribution allocation can be dynamic and depends on current jackpot states.
foreignConfigurationEvidenceNotExecution.guard: Do not transfer exact contribution percentages, stake cap, seed values, hot-window clock time, or allocation formula from Hungary to JOKERBET Spain.

mathematicalOpportunity.whyDifferentFromProgression: The rules explicitly change jackpot trigger probability as a visible external state (time-to-deadline) changes. A late-cycle spin can therefore have a different expected jackpot return from an early-cycle spin.

mathematicalOpportunity.stakeGuard: Do not assume minimum stake is optimal and do not assume probability is linear in stake. Only EUR 1.71 per bet is Timed-eligible; amounts above that are redirected to Progressive.
